purpose: Define the evidence contract and readiness criteria for each Brand3 dimension

coherencia.goal: Detect consistency of messaging, tone, visual identity, and positioning across owned touchpoints.
ready_requires: Minimum 2 distinct owned surfaces (homepage, about, docs, social bio, blog)
Visual consistency observable or intentionally distinct with explanation
Optional: at least 1 external source verifying the owned message claim
thin_is: Multiple surfaces exist but messaging is generic/boilerplate
Tone varies but limited surfaces make assessment difficult
blocked_is: Zero owned surfaces with meaningful text
Owned surfaces directly contradict each other (homepage says X, about says Y, LinkedIn says Z)
Evidence is only technical artifacts (robots.txt, schema, visual metrics)
coherencia.abstain_when: Zero owned surfaces or all evidence is technical
evidence_packet_validates: Owned surfaces correctly marked
Technical artifacts classified as technical, not coherencia
Visual-only metrics blocked
Minimum 2 surfaces for ready status
Empty-text evidence blocked

presencia.goal: Detect whether brand is discoverable and existent across relevant channels for its market.
ready_requires: Owned web domain exists, loads, has content, valid SSL, not 404 or redirect
Minimum 2 external channels detected (press, social, directory, Wikipedia, etc.)
Recency: last activity ≤ 90 days (for active brands; enterprise exceptions allowed with justification)
No evidence of abandonment (not archived, not domain squatter)
thin_is: Owned web presence but only 1 external channel detected
Multiple channels but activity > 120 days old
Only social presence or directory listing, no owned web
blocked_is: No owned web presence (404, no domain, redirect to unrelated site)
presencia.abstain_when: Zero owned domain or zero external channels
collection_must_provide: Owned web domain verification (SSL, HTTP status, content length)
No requirement for deep research; standard search sufficient
evidence_packet_validates: Owned domain verified (not 404, not parked)
Technical signals not counted as presencia
Related surfaces correctly classified as external
Minimum 2 channels with recent activity (≤ 90 days)
At least 40% external evidence

percepcion.goal: Detect what sentiment and themes emerge when external sources describe or mention the brand.
percepcion.epistemology: External perception only. Self-description is not perception.
ready_requires: Minimum 2 independent external sources mention brand with explicit sentiment/theme
At minimum 1 source is editorial or review-based (not marketplace listing or auto-aggregator)
Sentiment is detectable (positive, negative, neutral, mixed)
Themes are consistent or explicitly conflicted
thin_is: Multiple sources but all from same publisher/domain
Weak sentiment signal (mention without clear opinion)
blocked_is: Zero independent external sources with sentiment
Only self-published material (owned blog, press release)
percepcion.abstain_when: Zero external sources with sentiment (unless presencia is high; then absence is meaningful)
percepcion.note_on_zero: Absence of external perception can be valid data if presencia is high. Document as 'no detectable external perception' rather than low score.
collection_must_provide: External source discovery (news, reviews, social, forums)
Source role classification (editorial vs. listing vs. aggregator)
evidence_packet_validates: All percepcion evidence is external (no owned)
Minimum 2 independent sources
At least 1 editorial/review source
Sentiment is explicit
Trust/security signals are review-gated, not eligible

diferenciacion.goal: Detect whether brand claims or demonstrates something singular relative to category or direct competitors.
diferenciacion.epistemology: Relational/comparative. Requires competitor reference or category-distinctive language.
ready_requires: CONDITION 1: Direct comparative evidence exists (explicit competitor name) in owned claim AND echoed in ≥1 external source
OR CONDITION 2: ≥2 independent external sources use category-distinctive language (not generic) that uniquely positions brand
OR CONDITION 3: Competitor corpus provided by collection (Evidence Packet run on ≥2 direct competitors)
diferenciacion.critical_rule: Owned claims alone are NEVER sufficient. Must have external corroboration OR competitor comparison.
thin_is: Distinctive owned claims with zero external corroboration
External sources describe unique capability but brand doesn't claim it
blocked_is: Zero comparative evidence of any kind
All evidence is owned-only with zero external echo
All evidence is generic category language ('AI-powered', 'cloud-based', 'mobile-first')
Evidence is about price/scale/maturity, not positioning
diferenciacion.abstain_when: Zero comparative evidence AND zero distinctive external language AND no competitor corpus available
diferenciacion.competitor_corpus_requirement: When diferenciacion is blocked/thin and brand is in competitive category: recommend acquiring evidence on ≥2 direct competitors
collection_must_provide: Competitor evidence (if no direct comparative claims found)
evidence_packet_validates: Owned claims marked thin/blocked if no external corroboration
Generic category language not counted as differentiation
Comparative evidence has both owned AND external sources
Price/scale claims not treated as differentiation
Minimum 50% external evidence for ready
Dimension coverage check: if all blocked, report insufficient_comparative_evidence and abstain

vitalidad.goal: Detect whether brand is actively evolving, publishing, building, or in stasis/abandoned state.
vitalidad.epistemology: Temporal activity. Requires recent signals and evidence of change.
ready_requires: Last owned surface update ≤ 60 days old
Evidence of evolution (ONE of: changelog ≤90 days, blog post ≤90 days, social post ≤30-90 days, press mention ≤180 days, GitHub activity)
Activity is consistent (ongoing development, not one-off post then silence)
thin_is: Recent activity but inconsistent (months of silence between posts)
All activity is external (press mentions) with no owned surface updates
High-frequency but low-substance activity (daily posts, no feature substance)
blocked_is: No evidence of evolution or updates
Web presence frozen (same content from years ago, no changelog, no new posts)
vitalidad.abstain_when: Zero activity evidence AND brand context is unknown (B2B enterprise where activity is private, recommend Deep Research)
evidence_packet_validates: Activity is recent (owned ≤60 days, external press ≤180 days)
Changelog URLs have text content (no empty URLs)
Social profiles verified as official
Evolution evident (not just repeated posts)
Minimum 20% external evidence for high confidence

status.description: ready: meets all requirements; thin: has some evidence but missing depth; blocked: fails requirements; insufficient_input: cannot assess (e.g., no collection attempted)

review_gated.description: Evidence requiring manual review before finding use

blocked.description: Evidence not eligible (wrong type, empty text, etc.)

ready_coverage_percent.description: Eligible evidence / total evidence; must meet dimension threshold for ready status

external_coverage_percent.description: External evidence / total eligible evidence; must meet dimension minimum_externality_percent

recommendation.description: Next action if not ready (acquire competitor corpus, deep research, manual review, etc.)

gaps.description: List of specific evidence types or conditions missing for ready status

can_score.description: true: enough evidence to score; false: abstain (do not render a number)

score_if_ready.description: Placeholder; actual score determination by narrative engine

abstain_reason.description: If can_score=false, why abstention is required

coherencia.reason: Multiple owned surfaces (homepage, about, blog) with consistent 'AI Cloud' messaging. However, Evidence Packet v0 blocked visual metrics and some surfaces due to technical signal misclassification. Eligible evidence count = 1 but should be higher.
coherencia.recommendation: Re-validate visual coherence evidence handling; should not be technical-only block.

presencia.reason: Owned domain clear; 3 external channels detected (Wikipedia, press mentions implied, social profiles). However, 27% coverage suggests some external channels were review-gated. Recency is good (recent TechCrunch mentions).
presencia.recommendation: Verify social profile official status; may boost coverage.

percepcion.reason: 100% coverage (3/3 eligible). Multiple external sources with clear sentiment (TechCrunch mentions positive outcomes, blog posts demonstrate customer value). No contradiction.
percepcion.recommendation: Proceed to narrative; good external validation.

diferenciacion.reason: Zero eligible evidence. Vercel owns 'AI Cloud' messaging and 'Frontend Cloud' positioning, but Evidence Packet found zero external comparative language or category-distinctive corroboration. No competitor corpus in input.
diferenciacion.recommendation: This is an ACQUISITION GAP, not Evidence Packet failure. Run Evidence Packet on 2-3 competitors (Netlify, Railway, Fly.io) and create comparative matrix. Then re-evaluate diferenciacion.

vitalidad.reason: 100% coverage (7/7 eligible). Recent changelog activity, TechCrunch mentions (April 2026, recent security incident news), blog posts showing momentum. Clear evidence of ongoing development.

coherencia.reason: 0% coverage (0/5 eligible). Review-gated evidence suggests related surfaces (possible social profiles) not yet verified. Owned coherencia evidence likely blocked due to visual-only metrics.
coherencia.recommendation: Acquire deeper owned-surface text analysis; unblock visual consistency if it's message-independent (brand color consistency, layout patterns).

presencia.reason: 27% coverage (3/11 eligible). Owned domain clear; external channels detected but some review-gated (likely social profile ambiguity). Recency good.
presencia.recommendation: Verify official social profiles; should improve coverage to ~40%+.

percepcion.reason: 100% coverage (4/4 eligible). External sources with clear sentiment about LaunchDarkly's role in feature flagging/deployment. Consistent positive external perception.

diferenciacion.reason: 0% eligible; 3 review-gated, 2 blocked. LaunchDarkly has owned positioning in feature flag space, but no comparative evidence or category-distinctive external corroboration in input. No competitor corpus (e.g., Split.io, Unleash, etc.).
diferenciacion.recommendation: Acquire competitor corpus (Split.io, Unleash, etc.); run Evidence Packet on 2+ direct competitors in feature flagging space.

vitalidad.reason: 100% coverage (7/7 eligible). Clear changelog activity, ongoing development signals, external press mentions. Brand is actively maintained.

coherencia.reason: 0% coverage (0/10 eligible; 3 review-gated, 7 blocked). Kit entity ambiguity (builtwith.kit.com vs builtwith.com vs Kit owned claims) causes high blockage. Owned coherencia signals likely present but cannot be scored due to relation ambiguity.
coherencia.recommendation: This is ENTITY RESOLUTION FAILURE, not coherencia failure. Recommend Deep Research or manual disambiguation of Kit vs BuiltWith.com relation before retrying.

presencia.reason: 0% coverage (0/8 eligible; 1 review-gated, 7 blocked). Owned domain ambiguity (builtwith.kit.com is unclear canonical) and related-surface confusion (BuiltWith.com, Kit.com, builtwith.kit.com) cause universal blockage.
presencia.recommendation: ACQUISITION GAP: Input selection error. Should have audited kit.com (canonical domain) or explicitly clarified subdomain strategy. Cannot score presencia without clear owned domain.

percepcion.reason: 0% coverage (0/4 eligible; 2 review-gated, 2 blocked). Evidence likely exists but is mixed with BuiltWith.com and Kit references without clear relation.
percepcion.recommendation: Resolve entity ambiguity first (Deep Research or manual); then re-acquire percepcion evidence.

diferenciacion.reason: 0% eligible (1 review-gated, 3 blocked). Kit positioning unclear due to entity ambiguity; no comparative evidence in input.
diferenciacion.recommendation: Entity resolution required before diferenciacion evaluation.

vitalidad.reason: 0% eligible (7 review-gated, 0 blocked). Activity signals exist but cannot be scored due to entity ambiguity. Kit's changelog and social activity are present but relation to target entity is unresolved.
vitalidad.recommendation: Resolve entity (Kit vs BuiltWith) first; likely vitalidad will be ready after.

coherencia.reason: 9% coverage (1/11 eligible; 4 review-gated, 6 blocked). Some coherencia evidence preserved but low coverage suggests visual/technical signals were over-blocked.
coherencia.recommendation: Review visual coherence classification; may be incorrectly flagged as technical.

presencia.reason: 10% coverage (1/10 eligible; 1 review-gated, 8 blocked). Owned domain likely clear but external channels heavily review-gated or blocked. Suggests low external visibility or ambiguous profile detection.
presencia.recommendation: Verify social profile status and external channel discovery; currently too conservative blockage.

percepcion.reason: 25% coverage (1/4 eligible; 1 review-gated, 2 blocked). Low external perception evidence; may indicate low external visibility or perception is mixed/controversial (requiring review).
percepcion.recommendation: Clarify which external sources exist for Watermelon; may need deeper external search (Deep Research) if presencia is higher than perceived.

diferenciacion.reason: 0% eligible (3 review-gated, 1 blocked). No comparative evidence or distinctive external language in input.
diferenciacion.recommendation: Acquire competitor corpus (depends on Watermelon category; e.g., project management tools would need comparison with Linear, Asana, Monday, etc.).

vitalidad.reason: 0% eligible (5 review-gated, 1 blocked). Activity evidence exists but appears review-gated, suggesting ambiguous or unverified social/owned signals. May indicate low public activity or entity ambiguity.
vitalidad.recommendation: Verify owned surfaces and official social accounts; may unlock vitalidad evidence if relation is clarified.

diferenciacion_universal_failure.finding: All 4 cases (Vercel, LaunchDarkly, Builtwith/Kit, Watermelon) have zero diferenciacion evidence.
diferenciacion_universal_failure.root_cause: Input snapshots do not include competitor corpus. Evidence Packet can only classify evidence present; it cannot discover comparative evidence that was not collected.
diferenciacion_universal_failure.recommendation: Collection process must be updated to include competitor discovery for competitive categories. Evidence Packet alone cannot fix this.
diferenciacion_universal_failure.next_step: For each case, run Evidence Packet on 2-3 direct competitors and generate comparative matrix before evaluating diferenciacion.

entity_ambiguity_blockage.finding: Entity relation ambiguity (builtwith.kit.com vs builtwith.com vs Kit.com) causes universal evidence blockage across all dimensions.
entity_ambiguity_blockage.root_cause: Input domain selection error. Subdomain was audited instead of canonical domain.
entity_ambiguity_blockage.recommendation: Input validation: collection must enforce canonical marketing domain selection, not subdomains or partner-hosted pages.

social_profile_over_conservatism.finding: Official social profiles (LinkedIn, X) are review-gated as 'same-name external profile', reducing external evidence coverage.
social_profile_over_conservatism.root_cause: Evidence Packet v0 cannot verify official ownership from snapshot alone.
social_profile_over_conservatism.recommendation: Add official-link verification: if social profile URL is linked from owned domain (e.g., LinkedIn link on homepage), mark as verified official, not ambiguous.

visual_coherence_misclassification.finding: Visual coherence signals (color consistency, layout patterns) are classified as technical-only, blocking coherencia evidence.
visual_coherence_misclassification.root_cause: Current Evidence Packet treats all visual metrics as internal/technical. But brand-level visual consistency is part of coherencia messaging.
visual_coherence_misclassification.recommendation: Distinguish between internal visual metrics (contrast ratios, pixel alignment) vs. brand-level visual behavior (color palette consistency, logo usage consistency).

validation_rules.dimension_readiness_must_be_explicit: Every dimension must output a status (ready/thin/blocked/insufficient_input). No 'unknown' or 'unscored' values.
validation_rules.scoring_must_respect_readiness: If dimension status is blocked, score must not be rendered. If thin, document in findings but can score if implication is qualified. If ready, score normally.
validation_rules.competitor_corpus_must_be_triggered: If diferenciacion is blocked and brand is in competitive category, collection must flag that competitor corpus is required.
validation_rules.abstention_is_not_failure: A dimension that abstains (zero evidence, blocked status) is a valid and important finding. Do not force a score.
validation_rules.empty_text_evidence_must_be_blocked: Any evidence item with text='' or text=null must be classified as blocked, not eligible.
